name: ariadne-operation-scoped-finalization-across-20f1
instr:
Give resolver and integration code operation-scoped cleanup that follows a GraphQL operation to its true terminal boundary. Cleanup must behave consistently across queries, subscriptions, ASGI transports, SSE, and WSGI without altering established results or protocol behavior.

An `OperationFinalizers` registry runs active callbacks exactly once in reverse registration order, lets `FinalizerHandle.revoke` remove pending work, and raises `FinalizationClosed`, a `RuntimeError`, for late registration. Completion publishes one immutable `FinalizationReport`; `OperationFinalizers.report` exposes it, and repeated or concurrent completion returns that same fully formed report. Callback failures are recorded independently and never prevent remaining callbacks, replace GraphQL results, or conceal execution and transport failures; `FinalizationFailure` carries its `report`. `graphql`, `graphql_sync`, and `subscribe` expose one registry through `get_operation_finalizers(context)`, completing materialized queries immediately while transferring successful subscriptions until their producers terminate. Every ASGI HTTP, legacy `graphql-ws`, `graphql-transport-ws`, and SSE operation owns an isolated registry and maps completion, failure, cancellation, disconnection, cleanup failure, and racing terminal signals consistently. Existing GraphQL payloads, HTTP statuses, WebSocket messages, completion callbacks, and transport failures remain observable unchanged. `WSGIGraphQL` from `ariadne.wsgi`
